title: Adding time relative to capture start as Time Display Format
description:
This patch allows Time Display Format to support Time relative to
capture start.

notes.body: It probably makes sense to merge https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/21333 first and adjust this MR to use the new `frame_rel_start_time`

added 13 commits
  • deb023e9...750fc169 - 12 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 89b4d09d - Adding time relative to capture start as Time Display Format
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/21336/diffs?diff_id=1491426383&start_sha=deb023e9924bba3834644a1f8b8ef452c80c60fb)
There needs to be an entry added in `ts_type_values` in `ui/recent.c` for the new type, so it can be written to the recent file correctly.
Probably add the same action and entry to Stratoshark too?
I tried but I am not sure how to test it...

And I am also not so sure, if it is relevant for Stratoshark like for Wireshark. Are there logging formats that support it?

Also relative is already called in Stratoshark like this: `ActionViewTimeDisplayFormatSecondsSinceBeginningOfCapture` 

I guess we should create a new MR, if it makes sense for Stratoshark.

`ui/dissect_opts.c` needs an option for this so that it can be specified with `-t` at the command line, then added to the `doc/man_pages/dissection-options.adoc`, the help output at `ui/commandline.c`, `tshark.c`, `strato.c`, `rawshark.c`, and `doc/wsug_src/wsug_customize.adoc`.

The CLI version of IO Graph, `ui/cli/tap-iostat.c` also eventually ought to handle it.

All this command line stuff can possibly go in another MR (and possibly adding Stratoshark but it's easy for me to forget if I don't handle Stratoshark at the same time), but the entry in the recent file needs to be in this one.

> The CLI version of IO Graph, `ui/cli/tap-iostat.c` also eventually ought to handle it.

How would you test that?
The CLI I/O Graph uses the `-t` option to decide what sort of time column to display. It couldn't be implemented without the capture options support.
All that can probably go in a later MR.

I think it probably doesn't exactly *work* for `-t rc` in `-z iostat,` yet, because it will still grab the relative time from `pinfo->rel_ts`. It should I guess with the current code get the time from `pinfo->rel_cap_ts` instead, similar to what the new Plot dialog does.

I guess the GUI I/O Graph dialog needs that too eventually.

Adding time relative to capture start as Time Display Format

capture start.
